Content: A neighborhood committee is installing a protective wire fence around a new rectangular community garden to keep wildlife out. The garden layout has a length of `text(45 feet)` and a width of `text(30 feet)`.
What is the total length, in `text(feet)`, of fencing required to completely enclose the garden?

A marine canvas shop is sewing a reinforced canvas binding along the outer edges of a triangular sailboat jib. The sail is cut as an isosceles triangle with a bottom base of `text(12 feet)` and `text(two)` equal angled sides that each measure `text(18 feet)`.
What is the total length, in `text(feet)`, of the binding material needed to cover the entire perimeter of the sail?

A university maintenance crew is laying decorative LED string lights exactly along the outer border of a square central courtyard for an upcoming festival. The courtyard has a measured side length of `text(65 meters)`.
How many `text(meters)` of LED string lights are needed to outline the entire courtyard?

A contractor is installing wooden baseboards around the perimeter of a rectangular office suite. The room has a length of `text(55 feet)` and a width of `text(40 feet)`. The contractor must leave a `text(single 5-foot)` gap along one of the walls for the main entrance door, where no baseboard will be installed.
What is the total length, in `text(feet)`, of the baseboard required for the room?

A production crew is applying high-visibility safety tape to the outer edges of a trapezoidal outdoor performance stage. The front edge of the stage facing the audience is `text(30 feet)` long, and the parallel back edge is `text(50 feet)` long. The `text(two)` angled side edges are each `text(24 feet)` long.
What is the total length, in `text(feet)`, of safety tape required to cover the entire perimeter of the stage?

A logistics company is applying a protective epoxy coating to a new rectangular warehouse floor. The architectural blueprints show that the floor has a length of `text(120 feet)` and a width of `text(85 feet)`.
What is the total area, in `text(square feet)`, of the warehouse floor that needs to be coated?

A municipal parks department is planting a specialized drought-resistant grass seed in a flat, triangular traffic median. The base of the triangular median measures `text(40 yards)`, and the perpendicular distance from the base to the opposite tip (the height) is `text(15 yards)`.
What is the total area, in `text(square yards)`, of the median?

An aerospace engineer is designing a custom solar panel to fit onto a satellite's angled deployment wing. The solar panel is shaped like a parallelogram with a base of `text(24 inches)` and a vertical height of `text(18 inches)`.
What is the total surface area, in `text(square inches)`, of the solar panel?

A homeowner is hiring a contractor to build a flat, trapezoidal wooden deck in their backyard. The edge of the deck attached to the house is `text(30 feet)` long, and the parallel edge facing the yard is `text(22 feet)` long. The straight, perpendicular distance between these `text(two)` parallel edges is `text(14 feet)`.
What is the total area, in `text(square feet)`, of the deck?

A structural designer is cutting lightweight fabric for a high-altitude weather kite. The kite is perfectly shaped as a rhombus. The `text(two)` internal cross-bracing poles, which act as the diagonals of the rhombus, measure `text(36 inches)` and `text(45 inches)`.
What is the total area, in `text(square inches)`, of the kite fabric?
